item.title: LIV Golf makes huge return to Adelaide this weekend with John Summit, FISHER and four days epic of golf action
item.description: LIV Golf Adelaide returns in 2026 with a four-day tournament, blockbuster live music, family-friendly fun and festival vibes, cementing its place as one of South Australia’s most unmissable summer events.

item.title: FRINGE: Viral comedy hypnotist Matt Hale brings 90s chaos back to Adelaide for Fringe 2026
item.description: Australia’s viral comedy hypnotist Matt Hale returns to Adelaide Fringe with his sell-out show Funbelievable! 90s Rewind, promising nostalgic tunes, laugh-out-loud antics, and an unforgettable 90s party on stage.

item.title: The Garden of Unearthly Delights is back today! Here’s this year’s top shows to check out
item.description: The Garden of Unearthly Delights is headed back to Rundle Park once again for Fringe, delivering its most ambitious season yet with world-class shows and star-studded food experiences.

item.title: Sophie’s Hill Vineyard in the idyllic Adelaide Hills rolls out Italian-inspired afternoon beside the vines
item.description: Karrawatta Wines organises a leisurely Italian-inspired afternoon at Sophie's Hill Cellar Door next month, bringing together cannolis, pinot grigio, and good times.

item.description: Triple J Unearthed High winner George Alice makes her long-awaited return to the stage as headliner for the City of Adelaide’s free Music in the Square 10th anniversary, alongside Praise Mangena and Nat Luna.
